evidence_note: Values summarise official pages unless marked third-party; see docs/research/PROVIDERS.md for evidence labels, quotes and caveats. 'tested' describes only unauthenticated requests or vendor-published test/demo keys.

recommendation.contact_data_primary: Hunter.io (pilot on Free, then Starter $49/month or $408/year)
recommendation.verification: Hunter Email Verifier; optional MillionVerifier ($39 per 10,000 credits, never expire)

providers.name: Hunter.io
providers.api_on_plans: All plans including Free (API row checked for Free, Starter, Growth, Scale, Enterprise on the pricing comparison table).
providers.pricing_notes: Starter $49/month billed monthly or $408/year ($34/month); 2,000 credits/month. Growth $149/month or $1,248/year (10,000 credits). Scale $299/month or $2,508/year (25,000 credits). Credits reset monthly, no rollover. VAT treatment not stated.

credit_costs.domain_search: 1 credit per email found (0 if none); default limit 10, max 100 per call
credit_costs.email_finder: 1 credit per email found; free if none
credit_costs.email_verifier: 0.5 credit; free when result is unknown; disposables skipped
credit_costs.repeat: identical searches/verifications counted once per calendar month / billing period

providers.role_filters: Domain Search: department (hr, executive, management, education, ...), seniority (junior/senior/executive), job_titles, decision_maker, location (ISO country, POST), type, verification_status.
providers.found_vs_predicted: Distinguished: sources[] per email; /v2/email-finder/found returns only web-found addresses (source_type 'found'); standard Email Finder may return generated addresses.
providers.poland_coverage_evidence: None published; untested. Location filter accepts country codes (e.g. PL).
providers.terms_storage_rights: Terms silent on storing in own database; no post-termination deletion clause found; customer is an independent controller; Delaware law. Unclear but not restricted.
providers.gdpr_posture: Main servers on GCP Belgium; legitimate interest; Claim/opt-out; Art. 14 notices by Hunter not stated.
providers.tested: Unauthenticated only (2026-10-15): domain-search, email-verifier, account, email-count without key -> HTTP 401 authentication_failed; email-insight without key -> HTTP 200. Pricing HTML comparison table inspected.

providers.pricing_notes: Prices not present in fetched HTML (client-rendered). Third-party (search summary): Basic ~$49, Professional ~$79 per user/month billed annually. Credits do not roll over.

credit_costs.people_enrichment: 1 credit for email/demographics, +8 if mobile returned; 0 if nothing found

providers.role_filters: person_titles[], person_seniorities[] (owner, founder, c_suite, partner, vp, head, director, manager, senior, entry, intern), person_locations[], organization_locations[], q_organization_domains_list[], contact_email_status[]. No department filter documented for the API search.
providers.found_vs_predicted: Unclear (email_source field present but undocumented, null in example).
